basis_invariant_prefix_and_abel.sufficient_premise: P_j>=0 for every complete nonconstant positive eigenspace prefix. It is stronger than the target, not equivalent to it; its failure would not refute F>=1.
basis_invariant_prefix_and_abel.exact_abel_identity: F=q_0+sum_(j<m)(eta_j^(k-u)-eta_(j+1)^(k-u))P_j+eta_m^(k-u)P_m. For k=u,this is simply F=q_0+P_m. All coefficients are nonnegative. q_0=E K_l K_(r+u) K_(r+h+u)>=1 by the complete moment-square expansion.
basis_invariant_prefix_and_abel.zero_and_unit_modes: Zero modes have zero outerweight theta_i^k and zero a_j because u,k>=1; no zero eigenvalue division or0^0 is needed. Centered unit modes are retained in eta=1. If A is disconnected,the unit eigenspace must not be mistaken for constants only. The chosen constant phi_0 is separated,while the projection onto each centered complete repeated eigenspace is basis invariant.

proof: For independent x,y under mu,the six-coordinate product Z=R(x)R(y) has full-cube density2^-6[1+(1/4)(S_a(Z)+S_b(Z)+S_c(Z)+S_d(Z))],because the Fourier coefficients of the original density square under group convolution.

The four star signs have product1. Thus this density is positive for every Z except the8vectors whose four star signs are all-1. The kernel value1+sum s_e Z_e must be nonnegative at every such attainable Z.

Choose Z_e=-sign(s_e),with arbitrary signs at zero coefficients. If attainable,this gives sum|s_e|<=1. If forbidden,flipping any one coordinate changes the star signs at its two endpoints to+1,hence gives an attainable Z and the inequality sum|s_e|-2|s_f|<=1 for every f. In either case sum|s_e|-2min_e|s_e|<=1.
For any pair e,f,the remaining four magnitudes total at least4min|s|,so sum|s|-2min|s|>=|s_e|+|s_f|. This proves the pairwise bound,including zero coefficients and repeated maxima.

finite_proof: Expand the five full kernels other thanab into1+their centered spectral kernels;ab is fixed to M_C. Every proper surviving edge-subset core is a triangle,4cycle or diamond. Degree1vertices vanish. Triangles and4cycles have nonnegative eigenvalue weights by degree2orthogonality; diamonds have weights times actual squared cubic moments. The cutoff merely retains nonnegative scalar terms,so all these proper contributions are nonnegative.

A nonempty top prefix contains every mode withtheta=theta_max. Its abd triangle alone contributes at leasttheta_max^(3u),because all three triangle exponents areu and all three colors equal any included maximal mode.

For a nonzero full-centered tetrahedron assignment,each vertex's3incident coordinate colors must be one of the four stars. If some but not all selected vertex-stars are repeated,one of the vertices has two neighbors with the same different star;the two corresponding edge colors then coincide,so its cubic moment vanishes. Therefore either all four stars are equal or all four are distinct.

If all stars are equal,the four cubic signs multiply to+1. If all are distinct,the vertex-stars are a permutation of the four base vertices;there are24such assignments,each using all six distinct coordinate colors exactlyonce,each coefficient-1/16. For a fixedabcolor there are4negative assignments. A prefix can retain at most all24negative assignments.

Each negative spectral product has totaldegree3u+2r+h+l,so it is bounded bytheta_max^(3u+2r+h+l). Independently,its threeu-edge factors are bounded bytheta_max^(3u);among the remaining3distinct coordinate colors at least2 differ from a fixedmaximal color,and their magnitudes are at most1-m. Their exponents are at least1,so the remaining product is bounded by(1-m)^4. The other remaining factor is at most1.
The negative sum is therefore at most(24/16)theta_max^(3u)min(m^(2(2r+h+l)),(1-m)^4). Subtract this from the retained positive triangle anchor.

Ifm<=1/2,then2r+h+l>=4 givesm^(2(2r+h+l))<=1/256,and the coefficient is at most3/512. Ifm>=1/2,then(1-m)^4<=1/16,and the coefficient is at most3/32. The universal restricted-family lower bound29/32follows.
